objective: Determine whether the total price (excluding VAT) of the products listed on the old receipt in /uploads/ would be within 3 EUR of the old receipt's total if sold today.

params.receipt_file_path: read the file at /uploads/ (exact filename unknown; may need to list directory)
params.old_total_cents: extract the total price (excluding VAT) from the receipt file, in cents
params.product_skus: extract the list of product SKUs from the receipt file
params.current_prices: lookup from product_variants WHERE product_sku IN ($product_skus) to get price_cents
params.difference_cents: absolute difference between old_total_cents and new_total_cents

answer_shape.msg_skeleton: The total price difference is {difference_cents} cents, which is {within_3_eur ? 'within' : 'outside'} the 3 EUR threshold.
